verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of a published region list or a per-region service-availability matrix that an operations lead could check before deploying. The status page items describe incident and health status, not which services are offered in which region, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit. Region placement is clearly an applicable axis for a cloud platform, so the absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an operations lead, I can pick where things run — a published region list with per-region service availability I can check before committing
